translations.web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
translations.bsb: When Jesus said this, all His adversaries were humiliated. And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing.
translations.kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
translations.asv: And as he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame: and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
